title: Alien autopsy photos in S4 briefing
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Alien autopsy photos in S4 briefing, about 1988-1989 at S4, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I guess if you want to call it a gray something small. It had a T cut in the chest and there was one single organ removed from the chest.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien spacecraft in 1988 and 1989 at a secret site in Nevada called S4, says the briefing papers he read there included autopsy photos of a small being he calls a gray. He says it had a T-shaped cut in its chest and a single organ had been removed. If true, it would mean the US government holds alien bodies.
